adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then directly applies them to `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. From the same diff, the client computes `totalPages` as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, so `limit=0` (allowed by `.to_i`) yields division by zero/Infinity. Likewise, a negative `offset` is possible via `.to_i` and would be passed to ActiveRecord/PG (`OFFSET must not be negative`). The lack of an upper bound on `limit` is also shown in the diff (no max), enabling large member dumps in one request.
